notes.title: The swarm Beta 0.7.0A
notes.content:
Hello there ! 
First, thanks to everyone for playing and sharing this project !

So ! What's new in 0.7.0A ?
Less features than previous major Updates, but great features !

[b]Added :[/b]
- Final boss : Parasyte and it's musical theme
- New boss : Dart and it's musical theme
- New boss weapon : Beam
- Ultradash : you can avoid death 2 times before being killed (Upgrades will allow you to increase that number in a future update)

Parasyte :
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43191358/cb3b422471d5ded62f98b96689e29c5b703aa165.png[/img]

[b]Changes :[/b]
- Void burst now deal damage to everything that is trapped in
- HUGE Performance improvement on colissions
- Some Inapropriate messages has been removed from the random message list in the main menu

UltraDash :
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43191358/fbfccb9e14d3b1e88c3d2f948c8d3de5881cf418.png[/img]

[b]Fixed bugs :[/b]
- you can't use Void burst when you are on the "Retry screen" anymore
- you can now refocus on buttons in main menu when you use gamepad

Dart :
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43191358/6f8233cecb8665c42ffddb77f94f87ec0a5ce9db.png[/img]

Ultra dash recovery :
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43191358/02619ad0c5de606e6d28f2c19e065c96e271ee6d.png[/img]

Beam weapon :
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43191358/9479c727c63ed4c74d891113a8699255558689c8.png[/img]

[b]known bugs :[/b]
- The game freeze sometime in the menu or in game

notes.title: The Swarm Beta 0.6
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43191358/19736c66ff26eb002ed2b9a995ebc360e3bca1de.png[/img]
[b]The Swarm Beta 0.6 is now live ![/b]

Added :
- New Boss : Crab and its musical theme
- New common enemy : Glubbling
- New common enemy : Starfish
- Added a parameter for low performance Computer
- Added a parameter for low performance Player
- Added new sound effects and visual effects
- Added Boss variation for the Kraken
- Added Permanent upgrades in the main menu (Hearts of the sea are obtained by killing bosses)
- Added new Upgrade : Light Size 
- Player can now change default color in the Upgrade menu


New Boss : Crab
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43191358/49518c16a2a7ea481ddc1ba12a1137978621c567.png[/img]

Upgrade menu :
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43191358/731e7608b612dd9d671084cb970a5644dc164e1c.png[/img]

New Accesibility Parameters :
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43191358/1317b5a427f10d82793526a7301c4e986f2f173e.png[/img]


New Enemies : Glubbling and Starfish
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43191358/2b2d7cf7fce5c41a693d4e0d57faefa09b8ad71e.png[/img]


Changes :
- Menu visual improvement
- Player can now restart a new run right after dying without going back to main menu
- Camera now unzoom when the player is far from the boss
- Player default light size has been reduce to feet the new upgrade
- Unlock condition has been rework for Tardigrad and Covidax
- Void Burst charge faster


Restart a run :
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43191358/b8e2d413a22948b648657b69ef6cc4f7117e779b.png[/img]


Bug Fixes :
- Weapons that shoot projectiles that follow the play now work properly
- Removed the 0x0 resolution in resolution options list
- Tardigrade and Covidax can now be unlocked


[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43191358/9ea77c3320844e8697a77d7b0b724d7019ddbfcf.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43191358/edccae1f92c6ae1da37a40d0c33985efd515e54e.png[/img][/url]
THE DISCORD SERVER IS NOW OPEN TO PUBLIC !
https://discord.gg/Kv8paguVmN

notes.title: Beta Test 0.6.0C
notes.content:
[b]The Swarm patch 0.6.0C[/b]

[u]Added :[/u]
- Parameter for low perf config
- Parameter for low perf Player
- Boss Variants for Kraken

[u]Changes :[/u]
- Light size has been reduce to allow a better size increase with upgrades
- Menu visual overhaul

[u]Bug Fixes :[/u]
- Removed 0x0 screen resolution
- Upgrades Menu now display Upgrades info properly

This will be the last update befor Public release !
Enjoy ^^

notes.content:

- An ultimate fixe for the unclock boss issue (if it don"t work now i swear i will eat my keyboard)

Incoming features :
- Difficulty settings
- Low perf config Setting
- New ability
- New destructibles environental props

notes.title: Beta test 0.6.0A
notes.content:
[b]Patch 0.6.0A :[/b]

[u]Added :[/u]
- Possibility to retry a run right after dying

[u]Changes :[/u]
- Better sound management
- Crab is now easier

[u]Bug Fixes :[/u]
- Some bosses wasn't able to be unlocked. if it persist, Press Reset button in the menu or press "²" key to open the command consol and type "jesus christ" to unlock all bosses. available only during Beta
- Some weapons wasn't working properly


[u}On the way  :[/u]
- New Comon enemy
- Difficulty parameter
- Low config parameter

notes.title: The Swarm Beta 0.5
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43191358/3fd91e98c92cd0e76b499192302e35d69768322e.png[/img]
[b]The Swarm Beta 0.5 is now live ![/b]

[b]Bug Fix :[/b]
- Hammerhead Animation now works fine
- Projectiles now epxlodes at different times (performance issues)
- Tutorial stuck issue is now fixed
- Some random messages in the main menu wasn't displaying properly
- Player was redirected to the menu when being too far from the center of the map
- Player could stay stuck with a loaded shot

[b]New Feature :[/b]
- New Boss : Tardigrade
- New Notification system
- New Boss unlocking system
- New Power : Void Burst
- Added : Visual effect on the player when shot is fully charged
- Added : a crate that appear on the map and drop an upgrade when destroyed.
